formSection.title: Contact us
formSection.intro: You can contact us for RV repair, custom modification, Van Life, solar/lithium, water intrusion, roof work, inspection, maintenance, or parts. For modification, Van Life and solar projects from across Canada, include your city, province and whether the vehicle can be brought to Gatineau.

seoSections.heading: RV workshop in Gatineau, Canada-wide projects
seoSections.body: Clinique du VR serves Gatineau, Ottawa, Outaouais and the Laurentides for local requests. Custom modification, Van Life, solar and lithium projects can also be framed for clients across Canada when the vehicle can be planned for workshop work.

seoSections.heading: Before you send a message
seoSections.body: If you have photos, signs of water intrusion, roof or seal details, 12 V / 120 V equipment, propane, solar, batteries, or layout goals, include them in your message.
